Join Siemens Energy – Powering the Future At Siemens Energy, we are driving the energy transition and addressing the greatest challenge of our generation: reducing emissions while increasing energy supply. With over 150 years of innovation, our dedicated team of 98,000 professionals across 90 countries is at the forefront of electrifying the world.
A snapshot of your dayAs Finance Lead Data Steward, you will lead the practical implementation of data governance and stewardship across Siemens Energy Finance. You will ensure that Finance data has clear definitions, ownership, quality expectations, lineage, access controls, and lifecycle responsibilities. Working within the Digital Finance Data Team, you will partner closely with the Finance Data Domain Manager, Finance Data Stewards, business stakeholders, Product Owners, Data Architects, Data Engineers, and central governance teams. You will combine community leadership with hands-on governance work to establish trusted and reusable Finance data for reporting, analytics, automation, and AI. How youll make an impactLead and develop the Finance Data Steward community by setting priorities, coordinating activities, providing practical guidance, onboarding, and enablement.Drive the operational implementation of the Finance data governance framework in alignment with the Finance Data Domain Manager and enterprise governance standards. Advance the day-to-day governance operation through effective use and continuous improvement of tools such as Collibra and related capabilities.Lead Finance metadata management, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of business terms, data assets, Key Business Data Sets, and related governance records.Embed governance requirements into Finance data products, analytical solutions, AI use cases, business processes, platforms, and transformation initiatives.Provide governance expertise for data quality monitoring, remediation, proof-of-concepts, and Enterprise Data Quality Assurance processes. Represent Finance Data Governance in cross-functional and enterprise initiatives, translating Finance requirements into practical governance and data solutions.Build data literacy across Finance through training, engagement, and reusable guidance.What you bring5+ years of relevant experience in Data Governance, Data Stewardship, metadata management, data quality, Master Data Management, or Finance Data Management.Substantial experience with Finance data, processes, controls, and reporting requirements; deep expertise in at least one Finance discipline is an advantage.Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and communities and influence stakeholders across business, governance, and technology organizations.Hands-on experience with metadata management, data catalogs, ownership, lineage, and data quality, preferably using Collibra or a comparable governance platform.Familiarity with enterprise Finance data environments such as SAP, Snowflake, Power BI, or SAP Analytics Cloud, combined with strong facilitation and communication skills.Who is Siemens Energy?At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With 100,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but were also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible.
